Many people enjoy having the option of selling scrap gold as a means of making fast cash out of broken or non-functional gold jewelry. However, in such a case where you’re wondering about “how much is my scrap gold worth,” one must think prior about the process, the location, and most importantly, the factors that will ensure value. Rest assured, this article has you covered regardless if you’re looking to sell gold locally or online.

Here’s what we’ll cover in this article:

What Is Scrap Gold?

Selling Scrap Gold (Online) – What To Expect

Where To Sell Your Gold For The Best Price Without Getting Robbed

How much do Gold Buyers Pay for Scrap Gold on average?

What Is The Current Price of Scrap Gold?

A Guide to Cashing Your Scrap Gold Today

What Is Scrap Gold?

Scrap gold is identified as a gold item that is either not used anymore or is damaged. These include broken-off pieces of jewelry, out-of-date gold ornaments, gold fillings by dentists, and industrial waste that contains gold. Scrap gold can not be considered a collectible and is only useful for the amount of gold (karats) and weight that it has.

Selling Scrap Gold (Online) – What To Expect

Deciding to sell scrap gold has its perks as well, selling online means that you have a plethora of storage options along with access to reasonable prices. As for the majority of the online buyers, here’s what they would require you to do:

Free Shipping Kit: Trustworthy gold buyers will request to send you a shipping kit that would be prepaid and would provide you with protection against loss.

Send The Gold Over: Make sure that you wrap your articles properly and then send them over to the buyer for assessment.

Apply For: You will get an offer depending claims of the buyer of the weight and purity of your gold and the market rates.

Tip: Stick to online sites that have good reviews and good policies. Do not work with buyers who pay unreasonably low prices for their goods or have no proper certificates. 

Where To Sell Your Gold For The Best Price Without Getting Robbed?

You must be able to identify such a buyer to get the best deal. The following are your options:

Local Jewelers: Jewelers are trustworthy routes for evaluating and acquiring scrap gold. You can go to many outlets for shopping and comparison.

Gold Buyers: Scrap gold sellers usually have pawn shops but specialized gold buyers tend to pay more in these than the latter.

Online Gold Buyers: Such platforms are often reasonably priced and connected but always check the reputation of the company first.

Pawn Shops: The advantage is that cash is available instantly but sadly it is lower than the other two – gold sellers or jewelers.

Note: Going straight to a refinery instead of selling through an intermediary makes it more likely to earn a higher rate. However, individuals selling small amounts of the product might not be able to do so as not every refinery accepts them.

What is the current rate that jewelers offer for scrap gold?

It is common for a jeweler to pay anywhere between 60 to 80 percent of the gold scrap market price currently residing. This does not include the refining and melting costs though. Some jewelers may be competitive, but often many do not pay enough and it is best to wait for them to negotiate for the best price.

How much do Gold Buyers Pay for Scrap Gold on average?

Gold Buyers roughly buy below 70 to 90 percent of the market spot price, this depends on the following:

  • The purity of the gold up (karats).
  • The weight of the gold (grams).
  • Their profit margins and operational costs.

when selling gold, most gold buyers should be able to view the gold and assess it straight away, other gold buyers buy gold online and will send a report after.

What Is The Current Price of Scrap Gold?:

According to market conditions, the price of gold changes every other day. Take, for example, gold prices today, 24K gold which is termed as gold with no alloy in it is priced around $85.17 per gram while other lesser karat golds such as 18K or 14K will be priced lower. Before actually going to buyers make sure to use an online calculator to estimate the value of your scrap gold So that you can at least know what to expect before entering the market.

A Guide to Cashing Your Scrap Gold Today

The following text describes how you can easily turn scrap gold into cash, step by step:

Step 1: Prepare Your Gold: Check the karat your jewelry is stamped and get a digital scale to weigh your gold.

Learn: How to Check gold karat at home 

Step 2: Check Market Conditions: Always check how the gold market is performing, and how much it is selling for.

Step 3: Check For Reputed Buyers: If you plan to sell locally or want to sell online make sure to seek out buyers with a reasonable reputation that would allow their policies to be fair.

Step 4: Compare Different Offers: Reach out for multiple quotes so that you can compare different prices and make sure that you’re getting the very best deal.

Step 5: Cash In Your Gold: Once you’ve identified which offer you’d be better off with then go ahead and complete the transaction and sell your scrap gold for that amount.

Tip: Avoid clients who are trying to get you to close a sale too quickly or those who are liquidating the business up to 50% lower than the reasonable price.  

What Is The Value Of Scrap Gold In The Current Days?

Scrap gold prices plaster an array of costs and that is directly reliant on the prevailing gold spot prices. Gold spot prices can be defined as the price of pure unrefined gold which is $24k, For example:  1 gram of gold is going to cost $85.17.  

Gold Karat Price (USD) Purity (% of 24K)
24 Karat $85.17 100%
18 Karat $63.88 75%
14 Karat $49.68 58.5%

Note: that the values include other fees such as buyer fees, refining costs, and additional surcharges within your vicinity. Always check current live prices of gold before making a sale.

Conclusion:

To let go of excess items while earning income by selling them, scrap gold can serve as a wonderful option. The transactions can be made smooth and earn good profit by understanding its value, making many comparisons, and seeking suitable buyers making the transactions less tedious for all parties involved. Getting online buyers for “selling scrap gold jewelry near me” is easy but the more you know the better off you are.

If you would like to sell your antique gold jewelry piece for a hefty profit, then you must devise a sound plan and execute it. The selling process can also be beneficial if you need instant cash or simply want to declutter some items, but you must pick the right platform where your jewelry will be valued adequately. After reading this, you’ll be able to make a much more confident decision about selling your antique gold.tr

What Is Antique Gold?

Gold that is approximately fifty years old is antique gold. Antique gold, in comparison, is not just esteemed for its material but for its age, aspects, and individuality concerning the jewelry of today.

Other family heirlooms that were crafted include these pieces, including Victorian brooches and Art Deco bracelets. Most pieces have a glitz and glamour to them adorned with gemstones, or unique patterns that are used to represent the specific era.

What sets antique gold pieces apart is the fact that they are not mass-produced, each piece being unique to an extent that makes the item special. Moreover, antique gold’s relatively lower production cost has resulted in it being even more precious, including 22k and 18k gold.

How Will I Know How Much My Antique Gold Jewelry Is Worth?

Antique gold jewelry can be determined through multiple different factors.

Purity of the Gold:

Some traces of 22K gold (91.6 dated gold content) or 18K gold (75 dated gold content) can be detected on antique pieces. Gold’s finer content can be more valuable and yes such is not the case with lower karats due to their contents. Always check for stamps and hallmarks like “22K” and “18K” on your gold jewelry, it will save you from unwanted robbery.

Weight of the Jewelry:

 The cost of gold increases with its weight so if you have a thicker gold piece expect to get more for it. It’s commonplace to measure weight in grams or ounces. Kitchen scales are a good way to estimate weight, but professional jewelers employ much more precise measuring tools.

Design and Craftsmanship:

 Jewelers typically charge more for pieces with unique gold engravings or designs. Some pieces that are both historical and artistic are more expensive than just the gold in them.

Market Trends:

 It is advisable to watch out for the price of gold before deciding to sell so as to get the most out of the sale. Gold value changes with time so insights can save you the day while selling your products.

 Condition:

The value of the jewelry is enhanced with the improving conditions of the jewelry pieces. Evidence of repair can decrease value.

Gems/Diamonds:

Any gems or diamonds can add tremendous value to your piece. The quality (clarity, color, and carat weight) of the diamonds can also greatly determine the value of your piece.

Pro Tip: Antique bits having diamonds, sapphires, and rubies are naturally precious and thus, add to the worth of at the very least antique jewelry.

Where to Sell My Antique Gold for the Best Price

Although you may wish to sell your antique gold jewelry, such items should only be placed on certain platforms to maximize the selling price. The following are some places to consider for the sale of antique gold:

1. Local Jewelers

Selling antique gold pieces via local jewelers is a valid and excellent option. For example, enchanted jewelry specializes in gold assessment and most likely competes on pricing. Conduct research by reading reviews on jewelers that you want to sell antique jewelry in your area.

2. Online Sellers

Some antique jewelry pieces can be listed for sale on eBay, Etsy, and other specialized sites such as Worthy. That enhances the chances of reaching buyers as the competition is expanded across multiple online platforms so one is more likely to sell it for a higher price.

3. Auction Houses

When it comes to boldness and style, no men’s diamond watch has quite the appeal. They encapsulate luxury, elegance, and class most effortlessly. But certainly so, purchasing a diamond watch may turn out to be more of a cumbersome task as one has to differentiate between authentic pieces and worthless replicas constantly. The guide will cover everything there is to know about cheap diamond watches for men regardless of whether one is purchasing a real diamond watch or a fake one.

The beauty of watchmaking also allows one to possess real diamond watches which only highlights perfection in craftsmanship. Some important factors for consumers are the quality of diamonds, known brands, and whether such diamond watches have been previously evaluated. The top stars would already know a brand like Rolex, Cartier, or any other manufacturer that makes astonishing diamond watches. They can be a good long-term investment and last over time.

What Makes Real Diamond Watches Special?  

A diamond watch is not just a fashionable accessory; it is also a potent status symbol. This type of wristwatch features diamonds set into the bezel, dial, or bracelet, making it more expensive and aristocratic. These target clients who are looking for luxury diamond watches for men at a reasonable price as well

Is Cheap Real Diamond Watches Worth It?  

If you want to purchase a diamond watch, you do not have to spend vast amounts of money. There are some relatively inexpensive real diamond watches where real diamonds are used but of a smaller carat and with fewer settings and other adornments. These pieces suit individuals who are interested in owning a diamond-studded watch without breaking the bank. Affordable alternatives are offered by companies like Citizen, Bulova, and Seiko without compromising on craftsmanship.

Top Luxury Diamond Watch Brands  

For those seeking premium craftsmanship and unparalleled elegance, **luxury diamond watches** are the ultimate choice. The following brands are celebrated for their stunning designs and use of genuine diamonds:  

  • Rolex

Rolex is Famous for their accuracy and attention to detail with a combination of luxury, some of their popular models, such as the Day-Date and Datejust, come with diamond embellishments as well. if you want to know more about Rolex…

  • Cartier

Again, in the case of Cartier, their timepieces are adorned with diamonds where one would expect to find sophistication and design details rather than intricate decorations, for example, the Santos or Ballon Bleu.

  • Hublot

For men who prefer strong lines and modern styling, diamond watches from Hublot feature both new materials and new style sensibilities.

  • Patek Philippe

Their models are distinguished by the exquisite placement and cut of diamonds that are, in fact, masterpieces usually mounted on a Patek Philippe watch

 How to Spot a Real Diamond Watch  

The counterfeit trade can easily be witnessed in the diamond industry and for this reason, it is vital to know how to tell a genuine diamond watch apart from fakes. To this end, the following can be helpful:

1. Examine the Diamonds  

   Sparkle Test:

    Under light, real diamonds sparkle with both white and colored reflections.

   Feel the Edge:

   Ordinary stones tend to be smooth but genuine diamonds are fine-cut with sharp edges.

 2. Check the Brand and Documentation  

 Always buy from reputed brands or authorized dealers. Demand authenticity papers and the diamond used, including the carats and clarity.

 3. Material Quality

 Real diamond watches are produced from high-quality materials such as stainless steel, gold, or platinum.

4. Seek Expert Appraisal

If the owner is uncertain about the watch’s authenticity, having it assessed by an expert jeweler or gemologist is a smart option

 Features to Look for in Genuine Diamond Watches for Men  

If you’re investing in a **genuine diamond watch**, consider these features:  

1. Diamond Clarity and Quality

Look for watches that use diamonds graded for their clarity, cut, and color.  

2. Design and Aesthetics

   Make sure the design matches your style, whether simple or elaborate.  

3. Durability and Longevity 

    Ensure that the watch mechanism and materials are long-lasting since this will enhance the diamonds’ eternal brilliance

 Why Diamond Watches Are a Timeless Investment  

Diamond watches are elegant, but they also hold their value over time. High-end **luxury diamond watches for men** from brands like Rolex and Patek Philippe can be valued, making them an excellent investment. 

Tips for Caring for Your Diamond Watch  

To keep your watch looking its best, follow a regular cleaning plan.  

Clean Regularly:

 Use a soft brush and mild soapy water to clean the diamonds.  

Avoid Harsh Chemicals: 

To clean the diamonds, use a soft brush and mild soapy water. Avoid harsh chemicals. 

Store Properly: 

Keep your watch in a padded case to avoid scratches.  

FAQS:

Are diamond watches for men?

For both men and women, a diamond watch is a fashionable accessory. It is sophisticated and always in style.

Can men wear diamond Rolex?

Instead of choosing fully iced-out watches, consider these four models that offer a more subtle way to wear diamonds on a man’s watch. From a Submariner to an Air-King, here are four nice options for a men’s Rolex diamond watch.

How to tell if a watch has real diamonds?

Do you see bright white shimmers and colorful flashes of light? A real diamond shows exceptional brilliance and fire. In contrast, fake diamonds like Cubic Zirconia look duller and less reflective.

How do you clean a diamond watch?

  • Get a soft cloth and dampen it with warm water and mild soap.
  • Wipe your diamond watch gently with the cloth. Pay extra attention to the diamonds and the metal parts. 
  • Use a soft-bristled toothbrush to remove any debris and grime. 
  •   Wipe the watch down with a damp towel, then dry it with a soft, lint-free cloth. 

What diamonds can men wear?

Today, men often wear diamond rings. The most popular metals for these rings are white gold and platinum because they go well with many styles. The diamonds are arranged evenly along the band. Many people choose a black diamond or another dark gemstone instead.

 Final Thoughts 

Owning a real diamond watch is a real status symbol; regardless of whether you pick the cheap real diamond watches or the luxury diamond watches. The fact that a particular piece is original and the person knows how to spot a real diamond means that the watch is worth every penny as it will transform your entire look and last. For several years, I owned a Rolex Datejust.

It was amazing. The watch looks stunning, but the way it works reassures every expectation. The diamond-studded bezel and unmatched durability made every moment with it feel luxurious and special. Are you ready to make the decision? Find out more about the limitations of different diamond watch brands and choose a watch that fits you and your budget.

There was a time when for cash, selling gold was the most feasible option as it was highly liquid. But with people becoming more interwoven with the internet, it can get difficult in terms of selling or buying gold to your local client or gold buying and selling on an online platform, especially with many pros and cons for both. Selling Gold Online:

There are two ways to sell gold online, which are as follows: 

Online Gold Buyers: These platforms deal exclusively in buying gold, and competitive prices as well as services such as home pick-up are provided.

E-commerce Websites: A few e-commerce websites purchase gold, however, the prices may be different from each other.

Advantages of Selling Gold Online:

Convenience: You can get instant cash for gold at home without any effort. Gold buyers allow you to sell your gold without the need to step outside your house and visit multiple shops. Such a service can surely prove to be a game changer.

Affordable Goods: Any goods sold online can be offered at a lower cost as the seller doesn’t have to deal with a physical location.

Transparency: Reputable online platforms provide detailed evaluations and pricing breakdowns.

Disadvantages of Selling Gold Online

  • Risk of Fraud:  But such measures can only offer partial protection against the risk of fraud.
  • Identification Problems:  Another issue is on what basis does one inquire about the worth of an item or service especially if they have no prior knowledge or education and what if they have an antique service or item that they want to inquire about?
  • Time Delay in Payment: The primary reasons for selling gold online include better prices, and aspects like payment delay are a disadvantage to online buyers.

Selling Gold Offline

  1. Local Jewelers: A majority of people thinking of selling gold for cash in Los Angeles consider opting for local jewelers. This ensures that you are provided with a more personal experience and haggling can be done in person. However, prices charged by the different jewelers can greatly differ from each other.
  2. Pawn Shops: These are great places to start if you want to sell gold fast because most offer cash immediately, though the rates offered may not be as high as with other alternatives.

Advantages of Selling Gold Offline

  1. Instant Payment: Selling your gold jewelry to them allows you to get money immediately.
  2. Face-to-face interaction: It allows for a person to have a more interactive experience of asking and inquiring more with the seller as it is in person and direct.
  3. No Shipping Worries: As such there is no need to pay for a fairly expensive transport that may have the risk of ruining and losing the valuables.

Disadvantages of Selling Gold Offline

  1. Availability Of Buyers: However, the availability of buyers in Reginal if not Rural Australia compared to the city is quite limited.
  2. Knowledge And Expertise: In westernised societies the knowledge and expertise that both the buyers and sellers of gold possess is flawed.
  3. Inefficient mobility: The biggest issue that has been reported is mobility and transportation.

7 Important Tips Before Selling Your Gold

Know the Value Of your Gold: Before selling gold, try and determine what the CURRENT PRICE of gold is and how gold is sold based on weight.

Check Current Gold Rates: Check the current rate of gold, this way you’ll know when is a good time to sell to get the most profits.

Compare Prices: Always check who will give you the best price, do not accept the first offer that arises.

Choose a Trusted Buyer: Whether you are selling on the internet or at a physical store, find a seller who you can trust even if it takes time.

Ask About Fees: Many buyers do charge refining or processing purposes and cut from the total payout, be sure to fully understand these fees.

Negotiate: If you’re planning to sell your gold to a local buyer, be prepared to ask their price, and don’t be afraid to ask for more. Knowing how much gold you are selling can also be used to your advantage.

Get Multiple Quotes: Use this to your advantage and collect bids from multiple users so that you can find a buyer who will pay you what the gold is worth.

Is It Safe to Sell Gold Online?

Selling gold shouldn’t be a problem, make certain you are cautious about your valuables and use reputable buyers with good reviews, such buyers are known to check their seller’s certification and offer insurance on parcels. Ensure that the company has good policies on payments and transparency, this will help secure you more.

Our pricing policy is entirely transparent, making it a very safe and trustworthy gold dealer for those who are interested in selling gold as we always prioritize our customers.

Conclusion

In The end, both selling gold online and offline has some pros and cons. Selling online can provide access to various customers, and selling to locals allows for receiving cash immediately. In this case, consider your priorities, evaluate different customers to receive the best offer, and ensure the honesty of a potential buyer.

Payment methods should always be protected alongside reviews and certifications.

There’s a high chance because most offer cash or checks to buy gold instantly.

Yes, as they have more competition, they pay better rates.

mainHtml:
Luxury Watch Buyer Los Angeles – Sell Rolex & Luxury Watches

Sell Your Rolex, Cartier, AP, Patek Philippe, Omega & Other Luxury Watches

Looking to sell a luxury watch in Los Angeles? Visit Cash 4 Gold & Diamonds in Downtown Los Angeles for an in-person evaluation of your Rolex and other luxury timepieces.

Call Us

Get a Watch Evaluation

Looking for a luxury watch buyer in Los Angeles? Cash 4 Gold & Diamonds evaluates and purchases luxury watches at our Downtown Los Angeles Jewelry District location.

We evaluate watches from leading luxury brands, including Rolex, Cartier, Audemars Piguet, Patek Philippe, Omega, Breitling, and other desirable watchmakers.

The value of a luxury watch depends on much more than the brand name. Model, reference number, condition, age, materials, movement, originality, service history, box and papers, accessories, and current resale demand can all influence an offer.

Bring your watch to our Los Angeles location for an in-person evaluation. If you have the original box, warranty card, papers, receipts, service records, or extra links, bring those as well. They can be helpful, but are not necessarily required.

After the watch has been examined, we can provide an item-specific offer that you can consider before deciding whether to sell.

How to Sell Your Luxury Watch

Bring In Your Luxury Watch

Schedule an appointment, call ahead, or visit our Downtown Los Angeles location with your watch and any box, papers, receipts, service records, or accessories you have.

Watch Evaluation

We examine important details such as the brand, model, reference, condition, authenticity, materials, movement, originality, accessories, and current market demand.

Receive Your Offer

After evaluating the watch, we explain our offer so you can decide whether selling is right for you. There is no obligation to sell simply because you receive an evaluation.

Speak With Us

Luxury Watch Brands We Evaluate

We evaluate many desirable luxury watch brands. Market demand varies by brand, model, reference, age, condition, and configuration.

  • Rolex
  • Patek Philippe
  • Audemars Piguet
  • Cartier
  • Omega
  • Breitling

Sell Your Rolex Watch in Los Angeles

Rolex is one of the most recognized names in the luxury watch resale market, but the value of one Rolex can differ significantly from another.

When evaluating a Rolex, relevant factors can include the model, reference number, production period, condition, dial, bracelet, materials, originality, box and papers, service history, and current demand for that particular configuration.

Popular Rolex collections can include models such as the Submariner, Daytona, GMT-Master II, Datejust, Day-Date, Explorer, Yacht-Master, and others.

If you have the original Rolex box, warranty card, papers, receipt, service records, or extra bracelet links, bring them with the watch.

For more detail, read our guide to selling a Rolex locally and how to sell a Rolex watch in Los Angeles.

We Buy More Than Rolex

Luxury watch value extends well beyond Rolex. We also evaluate watches from other desirable manufacturers, including Cartier, Audemars Piguet, Patek Philippe, Omega, Breitling, and other luxury brands based on current market demand.

Depending on the watch, important factors may include the specific collection, reference number, case material, dial configuration, movement, condition, originality, age, accessories, and current secondary-market demand.

What Determines the Value of a Luxury Watch?

There is no single price guide that determines what every luxury watch is worth. The value of a particular watch depends on several characteristics working together.

Brand and Model

Certain manufacturers, collections, and references have stronger secondary-market demand than others.

Reference Number

The exact reference can identify important differences between watches that may initially look very similar.

Condition

Case, bracelet, crystal, dial, bezel, movement, and overall wear can affect desirability and value.

Originality

Original components can matter to collectors. Replacement or aftermarket components may influence an evaluation depending on the watch.

Materials

Stainless steel, gold, platinum, two-tone construction, diamonds, and other materials can affect the value of a watch.

Box and Papers

Original warranty cards, certificates, boxes, receipts, manuals, hang tags, service records, and extra links can be helpful when evaluating provenance and completeness.

Current Market Demand

Luxury watch resale markets change. Demand for specific brands, models, references, dial configurations, sizes, and materials can influence what buyers are willing to pay.

How We Evaluate a Luxury Watch

A luxury watch evaluation can involve examining identifying characteristics of the watch, including its case, dial, bracelet, movement when appropriate, reference information, materials, condition, and other details.

The purpose is to understand exactly what watch is being presented and the factors relevant to its current resale market. Some watches may require additional authentication or research before an evaluation can be completed.

What Should I Bring When Selling My Watch?

  • The watch
  • Original box, if available
  • Warranty card or papers, if available
  • Original purchase receipt, if available
  • Service records
  • Extra bracelet links
  • Additional straps or accessories originally supplied with the watch
  • Relevant documentation

Do not worry if you no longer have every accessory. Bring the watch and whatever documentation or accessories remain, and we can determine what information is relevant during the evaluation.

Selling a Luxury Watch Locally vs. Online

Owners have several options when selling a luxury watch, including a direct local buyer, online marketplace, consignment company, or auction house.

Direct Local Watch Buyer

A local direct buyer allows the watch to be examined in person and gives the owner an opportunity to consider an item-specific offer without first shipping the watch to an unknown destination.

Online Marketplace

Selling directly to another consumer may require creating a listing, photographing the watch, communicating with buyers, handling payment, shipping, returns, and platform requirements.

Consignment

With consignment, the watch is generally marketed to another purchaser before the owner receives proceeds. Fees and timelines vary by company.

Auction

Auctions may be appropriate for certain rare or collectible watches, but fees, reserves, schedules, and results vary depending on the auction house and specific watch.

Compare the Final Offer for Your Actual Watch

When comparing luxury watch buyers, an early estimate is not necessarily the same thing as the final offer for the actual watch.

The watch’s exact reference, condition, originality, accessories, and other characteristics may not be fully known until the watch is examined.

Before deciding where to sell, consider the final item-specific offer and ask how the buyer arrived at the valuation.

Why Sell Your Luxury Watch to Cash 4 Gold & Diamonds?

Cash 4 Gold & Diamonds provides in-person luxury watch evaluations from our location in the Downtown Los Angeles Jewelry District. We have served Los Angeles customers since 2007.

Customers can bring their watches directly to our physical location, discuss the watch in person, receive an evaluation, and decide whether an offer is right for them.

  • Downtown Los Angeles location
  • In-person watch evaluation
  • Rolex and other luxury brands evaluated
  • Box and papers helpful but not necessarily required
  • Item-specific offers
  • No obligation to sell
  • Established Los Angeles business

Read our customer reviews to learn about other sellers’ experiences.

Luxury Watch Buyer in Downtown Los Angeles

Cash 4 Gold & Diamonds is located at 617 S. Hill Street, Los Angeles, CA 90014, in the Downtown Los Angeles Jewelry District.

If you are looking for a place to sell a Rolex or another luxury watch in Los Angeles, California, you can bring the watch to our physical location for an in-person evaluation.

Have other items to sell? We also evaluate diamonds and diamond jewelry and gold jewelry.

Frequently Asked Questions About Selling Luxury Watches in Los Angeles

Where can I sell a luxury watch in Los Angeles?

Cash 4 Gold & Diamonds evaluates luxury watches at our Downtown Los Angeles Jewelry District location. Bring your watch and any available box, papers, receipts, service history, or accessories for an in-person evaluation.

Can I sell a Rolex without the box and papers?

You can still bring a Rolex for evaluation if you no longer have the original box or papers. Documentation and accessories can be helpful, but the watch itself and its specific characteristics are central to the evaluation.

What determines how much my Rolex is worth?

Factors can include the exact model and reference, condition, production period, materials, dial configuration, bracelet, originality, box and papers, service history, and current market demand.

Do you buy watches besides Rolex?

Yes. We evaluate luxury watches from brands including Cartier, Audemars Piguet, Patek Philippe, Omega, Breitling, and other desirable manufacturers, depending on the specific watch and current market demand.

Should I service or polish my watch before selling it?

Not necessarily. Before paying for service or polishing, it can be useful to have the watch evaluated in its current condition. On collectible watches, originality can be important, and unnecessary polishing may not always be desirable.

Does having the original box and papers matter?

Original documentation and accessories can help establish completeness and provenance. Their impact varies depending on the particular watch, model, age, and market.

Can I sell an older or vintage luxury watch?

Potentially, yes. Age alone does not determine value. Brand, reference, rarity, originality, condition, movement, history, and collector demand may all be relevant.

How do I compare offers from watch buyers?

Compare the final offer for your actual watch and ask what factors were considered. Preliminary estimates may change after the watch’s exact reference, condition, originality, and accessories are verified.

Do I need an appointment?

You can book an appointment through our contact page or call 310-663-1340 to arrange your visit and confirm availability.

See our general selling FAQs for more information.

Ready to Sell Your Luxury Watch in Los Angeles?

Bring your Rolex or other luxury watch to Cash 4 Gold & Diamonds in Downtown Los Angeles for an in-person evaluation.

Bring the original box, papers, warranty card, receipts, service records, and extra links if you still have them. If some of those items are missing, bring what you have.

Find out what factors affect your watch’s current resale value and receive an item-specific offer to consider.

Call Cash 4 Gold & Diamonds

Get a Watch Evaluation

mainHtml:
Diamond Buyers Los Angeles – Sell Your Diamonds for Cash

Discover What Your Diamond Is Worth Today

Book an Appointment

Looking for trusted diamond buyers in Los Angeles? Cash 4 Gold & Diamonds buys loose diamonds, GIA-graded diamonds, engagement rings, diamond jewelry, estate diamonds, and diamonds of many shapes, sizes, colors, and clarity grades.

Visit our Downtown Los Angeles Jewelry District location for an in-person diamond evaluation. We examine the characteristics that affect a diamond’s resale value, including carat weight, cut, color, clarity, shape, condition, certification, and current market demand.

If your diamond has a GIA grading report or other documentation, bring it with you. Documentation can help us verify important characteristics of the stone, but we can also evaluate diamonds that do not have their original paperwork.

After evaluating your diamond, we can provide an offer based on the specific stone and current resale market conditions. There is no obligation to sell simply because you receive an evaluation.

Book a Diamond Evaluation

What Types of Diamonds Do We Buy in Los Angeles?

We evaluate many types of diamonds and diamond jewelry, including:

  • GIA-graded diamonds
  • Loose diamonds
  • Natural diamonds
  • Engagement rings
  • Diamond wedding rings
  • Diamond earrings
  • Diamond necklaces
  • Diamond bracelets
  • Estate and inherited diamond jewelry
  • Vintage diamond jewelry
  • Designer diamond jewelry
  • Diamonds set in gold or platinum jewelry

If you are unsure what you have, bring the item in for evaluation rather than trying to determine its value from photographs or online calculators alone.

Schedule Your Diamond Evaluation

Book a private appointment online, call us, or visit our Downtown Los Angeles location for an in-person diamond evaluation.

Expert Diamond Evaluation

We examine your diamond’s carat weight, cut, color, clarity, shape, condition, certification, and other factors that can affect its resale value.

Receive Your Offer

After the evaluation, we explain our offer so you can decide whether selling your diamond is right for you. If you accept the offer, available payment options may include cash, check, or bank transfer.

Speak With Us

Understanding Your Diamond Before You Sell

Selling a GIA Diamond in Los Angeles

A GIA grading report can provide important information about a diamond, including its carat weight, color, clarity, cut grade when applicable, measurements, proportions, and identifying characteristics.

If your diamond has its original GIA report, bring the report with you. We can use the grading information together with an inspection of the actual diamond and current market conditions when evaluating the stone.

A grading report does not by itself determine the amount a buyer will pay. Two diamonds with similar laboratory grades can have different resale demand and market values depending on characteristics such as shape, measurements, cut quality, fluorescence, condition, and current buyer demand.

How Is a Diamond’s Value Determined?

There is no single price-per-carat number that accurately values every diamond. Several characteristics work together to influence resale value.

Carat Weight

A diamond’s carat weight measures its weight, but larger diamonds do not simply increase in value at the same rate per carat. Size thresholds, quality, shape, and market demand can significantly affect value.

Cut

Cut and proportions affect how effectively a diamond reflects light and can influence both appearance and market desirability.

Color

For many colorless diamonds, less visible body color can affect grading and market value. Fancy-color diamonds are evaluated differently.

Clarity

Clarity considers inclusions and blemishes, including their size, number, position, and visibility.

Other important factors can include diamond shape, measurements, fluorescence, laboratory report, condition, brand or setting, and current wholesale and resale demand.

Sell Your Diamond Engagement Ring in Los Angeles

If you are selling a diamond engagement ring, we evaluate both the center diamond and the ring itself. Depending on the piece, factors such as additional diamonds, precious-metal content, designer branding, condition, and documentation may also affect the overall evaluation.

Bring any GIA reports, receipts, original boxes, designer documentation, or other paperwork you still have. These items are helpful when available, but they are not required for us to examine your jewelry.

Speak With Us

Why Sell Your Diamond to Cash 4 Gold & Diamonds?

Our goal is to make selling a diamond in Los Angeles straightforward and transparent. You can bring your diamond to our Downtown Los Angeles Jewelry District location for an in-person evaluation and receive an offer based on the characteristics of your specific item and current market conditions.

There is no obligation to sell after receiving an evaluation.

  • In-person diamond evaluation
  • Downtown Los Angeles Jewelry District location
  • GIA-graded and non-certified diamonds evaluated
  • Loose diamonds and diamond jewelry accepted
  • Engagement rings and estate jewelry evaluated
  • Clear explanation of the offer
  • No obligation to sell

Read our customer reviews to learn about other sellers’ experiences.

Get an Item-Specific Diamond Offer

When comparing diamond buyers, focus on the final offer for your actual diamond rather than relying only on an estimated price given before the stone is inspected.

A diamond’s value cannot be determined accurately from carat weight alone. The complete characteristics of the diamond and current market demand matter.

Ask how the offer was determined and compare final, item-specific offers before deciding where to sell.

Local Diamond Buyer vs. Consignment or Auction

There are several ways to sell a diamond. The right choice depends on whether your priority is convenience, speed, or potentially waiting for a future buyer.

Direct Local Diamond Buyer

A direct buyer evaluates the diamond and can make an offer for the item. This allows the seller to decide whether to accept an offer without waiting for the jewelry to sell to another consumer.

Consignment

With consignment, the jewelry is generally listed for sale and the seller waits for another buyer to purchase it. Terms, fees, and timelines vary by company.

Auction

Auction may be appropriate for certain rare, important, or highly desirable pieces. Auction fees, timing, reserves, and results vary depending on the auction house and item.

Have other items to sell? We also evaluate gold jewelry and luxury watches.

Book a Diamond Evaluation

Frequently Asked Questions About Selling Diamonds in Los Angeles

Where can I sell a diamond in Los Angeles?

Cash 4 Gold & Diamonds evaluates diamonds at our location in the Downtown Los Angeles Jewelry District. We evaluate loose diamonds, engagement rings, diamond jewelry, estate pieces, and GIA-graded diamonds.

Do I need a GIA certificate to sell my diamond?

No. A GIA report or other laboratory documentation is helpful when available, but you can still bring a diamond for evaluation without its original paperwork.

What determines how much my diamond is worth?

Diamond value can depend on carat weight, cut, color, clarity, shape, measurements, condition, laboratory grading, fluorescence, and current resale demand.

Do you buy loose diamonds?

Yes. We evaluate loose diamonds as well as diamonds mounted in engagement rings and other jewelry.

Can I sell an engagement ring?

Yes. We evaluate diamond engagement rings and consider the center stone as well as relevant characteristics of the setting, additional stones, precious metals, branding, condition, and documentation.

Should I bring my GIA report?

Yes, if you have it. Bring the original GIA report and any other relevant documentation, receipts, boxes, or designer paperwork that may help identify the item.

How do I compare offers from diamond buyers?

Compare the final offer for your actual diamond and ask how the buyer determined the offer. Estimates given before physical inspection may change after the diamond’s characteristics are verified.

Is a diamond evaluation the same as an insurance appraisal?

Not necessarily. An insurance or replacement-value appraisal serves a different purpose from an offer to purchase a diamond in the current resale market.

For general questions about visiting or selling jewelry, see our FAQs.

Ready to Sell Your Diamond in Los Angeles?

Bring your loose diamond, engagement ring, or diamond jewelry to Cash 4 Gold & Diamonds in the Downtown Los Angeles Jewelry District for an in-person evaluation.

If you have a GIA report, receipt, box, or other documentation, bring it with you. If you do not have paperwork, we can still examine your diamond.

California Jewelry Mart
617 S. Hill Street
Los Angeles, CA 90014

Book a Diamond Evaluation or call 310-663-1340.

Book a Diamond Evaluation

mainHtml:
Cash 4 gold & Diamonds Website Privacy Policy

Last Privacy Policy Update: 4/30/24. This document governs the privacy policy of our Website, https://cash4goldanddiamond.com//. We recognize that privacy and confidentiality are important to our visitors and customers. This page describes in detail the privacy practices that apply to all of our web and marketing services

DEFINITIONS

“Non-Personal Information” (NPI) is information that is in no way personally identifiable and that is obtained automatically when you access our Website with a web browser. “Personally Identifiable Information” (PII) is non-public information that is personally identifiable to you and obtained for us to provide you with a product or service. PII may include information such as your name, address, phone number, credit card information, and other related information that you provide to us.

OUR COMMITMENT TO YOUR PRIVACY

Our Privacy Policy tells you what PII we may collect from you, how we may share your PII, and how you can limit our sharing of your PII.

Cash 4 gold & Diamonds is committed to the security and privacy of all our customers. We take your privacy seriously, and we will work with you to ensure that you have an enjoyable online experience. We resepect your privacy and recognizes the need for appropriate protection and management of your PII you share with us.

OTHER WEBSITES

Our Website may contain links to other websites. You understand that these websites are not under our control and are not subject to our Privacy Policy. These websites will likely have their own privacy policies. We have no responsibility for these websites and provide links to these websites solely for your convenience.

You acknowledge that your use and access to these other websites is solely at your own risk. It is your responsibility to check the privacy policies of these other websites to see how they treat your personal information.

INFORMATION WE COLLECT

We collect personal information when you register to request information about our services, sign up for a consultation, download one of our guides, or otherwise voluntarily provide such information. This information includes the following categories:

Personal Contact Information
Business Information
Budget Information

Generally, you control the amount and type of information you provide to us when using our Website. As a visitor to our Website, you can browse our Website to find out more about us. You are not required to provide us with any PII as a Visitor.

We offer you choices when we ask for personal information, whenever reasonably possible. You may decline to provide PII to us in our registration forms and/or refuse cookies in your browser, although some of our features or services may not function properly as a result. We make good-faith efforts to provide you access to your personal information upon request and to let you correct such data if it is inaccurate and delete it, when reasonably possible.

COMPUTER INFORMATION COLLECTED

When you use our Website, we automatically collect certain computer information by the interaction of your mobile phone or web browser with our Website. Such information is typically considered NPI. We may also collect any of the following:

COOKIES

Our Website uses “Cookies.” A Cookie is a small piece of data stored on your computer or mobile device by your web browser. We use Cookies to identify the areas of our Website that you have visited. We also use cookies and other technologies to enhance your online experience by eliminating the need to register multiple times for registration-required content. Finally, we may use Cookies to personalize the Content that you see on our Website. Most web browsers allow you to disable the use of Cookies (see below). However, if you disable Cookies, you may not be able to access features on our Website correctly or at all. We never place PII in Cookies.

AUTOMATIC INFORMATION

In the interest of providing our visitors and customers with a secure online experience, our servers automatically record information when you visit our website, including the URL, IP address, device type, browser type and language, and the date and time of your request. We use all of this information to analyze trends among our users to help improve our Website.

GOOGLE AD AND CONTENT NETWORK PRIVACY POLICY

We may use Google Cookies on our site. Google, as a third-party vendor, uses cookies to track visitor information on our site. Google’s use of the DART cookie enables it to serve ads to our users based on their visit to our site and other sites on the Internet. Users may opt out of the use of the DART cookie by visiting the Google ad and content network privacy policy at the following link: https://www.google.com/policies/technologies/ads

GOOGLE ANALYTICS PRIVACY POLICY

Our website uses “Google Analytics” to collect information about the use of our site. Google Analytics collects information such as how often users visit our site, what pages they visit when they do so, and what other sites they used prior to coming to our site. We use the information we get from Google Analytics to improve our site. Google Analytics collects only the IP address assigned to you on the date you visit our site, rather than your name or other identifying information. We do not combine the data collected through the use of Google Analytics with personally identifiable information. Although Google Analytics plants a permanent cookie on your web browser to identify you as a unique user the next time you visit our site, the cookie cannot be used by anyone but Google. Google’s ability to use and share information collected by Google Analytics about your visits to our site is restricted by the Google Analytics Terms of Use, which you can read at: https://www.google.com/analytics/terms/us.html. You can prevent Google Analytics from recognizing you on return visits to this site by disabling cookies on your browser. https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout

FACEBOOK PIXEL

Our website uses the Facebook Pixel to collect information. The Facebook Pixel collects information such as what pages users visit when they are on our site. We use this information to serve up targeted advertisements on Facebook. You can learn more about the Facebook Pixel here: https://www.facebook.com/business/help/742478679120153?id=1205376682832142

HOW INFORMATION IS USED

We use the information we receive from you as follows:

PROVIDING REQUESTED SERVICES AND PRODUCTS

We may use PII to provide the inbound marketing services you’ve requested, including communicating with you about technical issues, new products and services, and other information of interest to you. We may also use PII for auditing, research, and analysis to operate and improve our inbound marketing technologies and services.

PROVIDING AND IMPROVING OUR WEBSITE

We may use the PII you provide to us, along with any computer information we receive, to provide our Website to you and make improvements to it.

COMMUNICATIONS AND EMAIL ALERTS

When we communicate with you about our Website, we will use the email address you provided when registering. We may also send you Website alerts regarding your use of our Website. Finally, we may also send you emails with promotional information about our Website or offers from us or our affiliates, unless you have opted out of receiving such information. You can change contact preferences at any time through your account. You can opt out of promotional messages. You can also opt out of receiving Website alerts.

SHARING INFORMATION WITH AFFILIATES AND OTHER THIRD PARTIES

We do not sell, rent, or otherwise provide your PII to third parties for marketing purposes. However, we may use your Non Personal Information for data aggregation purposes which might be sold to other parties at our discretion. Any such data aggregation would not contain any of your PII. We may provide your PII to affiliates that provide services with regards to our Website (i.e. payment processors, web hosting companies, etc.); such affiliates will only receive information necessary to provide the respective Websites and will be bound by confidentiality agreements limiting the use of such information.

LEGALLY REQUIRED RELEASES OF INFORMATION

We may be legally required to disclose your PII, if such disclosure is (a) required by subpoena, law, or other legal process; (b) necessary to assist law enforcement officials or government enforcement agencies; (c) necessary to investigate violations of or otherwise enforce our Legal Terms; (d) necessary to protect us from legal action or claims from third parties including you and/or other Members; and/or (e) necessary to protect the legal rights, personal/real property, or personal safety of our company, our users, employees, and affiliates.

DISCLOSURES TO SUCCESSORS

If our business is acquired or merges, in whole or in part, with another business that would become responsible for providing the Website to you, we retain the right to transfer your PII to the new business. The new business would retain the right to use your PII according to the terms of this Privacy Policy as well as to any changes to this Privacy Policy as instituted by the new business.

CHANGING YOUR INFORMATION

You may change your PII at any time using facilities found on our Website. If you need assistance with updating your PII or removing yourself from our mailing lists, just send us an email with your request or contact us using the Contact us information found on our Website.

OPTING OUT OF SHARING INFORMATION

You can always opt out of future unaffiliated third-party disclosures of your information. Such opt-out will not affect disclosures otherwise permitted by law including but not limited to: (i) disclosures to affiliates, (ii) disclosures to third-party service providers who provide certain services for our business, such as credit card processing, computer system services, shipping, data management, or promotional services, (iii) disclosures to third parties as necessary to fulfill your requests, (iv) disclosures to governmental agencies or law enforcement departments or otherwise required to be made under applicable law, (v) previously completed disclosures to third parties, or (vi) disclosures to third parties in connection with subsequent contests or promotions you may choose to enter, or third-party offers you may choose to accept.

“DO NOT TRACK” SETTINGS

Some web browsers have settings that enable you to request that our Website does not track your movement within our Website. Our Website does not obey such settings when transmitted to and detected by our Website. However, this does not change our compliance in any other way with our Privacy Policy.

Change and turn off tracking features in your browser. You can turn off tracking features and other security settings in your browser by visiting the following links: For Internet Explorer visit HERE: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/change-security-and-privacy-settings-for-internet-explorer-11-9528b011-664c-b771-d757-43a2b78b2afe#ie=ie-11

For Mozilla Firefox visit HERE.https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/how-do-i-turn-do-not-track-feature

For Google Chrome visit HERE. https://support.google.com/accounts/answer/61416?hl=en

For Safari visit HERE https://support.apple.com/guide/safari/prevent-cross-site-tracking-sfri40732/mac

Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on. Google provides a free add-on to most major browsers that you can install to prevent your data from being collected and used by Google Analytics. Visit the following link to download the free Google Opt-out Add-on Tool HERE https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout

PROTECTING YOUR CHILD’S PRIVACY

We follow the Children’s Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA). Even though our Website is not designed for use by anyone under the age of 18, we realize a child may attempt to access our site. We do not knowingly collect PII from a child. If you are a parent or guardian and believe your child is using our Website, please contact us. We may ask for proof of identification before we remove any information to prevent malicious removal of account information. If we discover on our own that a child is accessing our Website, we will delete the information as soon as we discover it, we will not use the information for any purpose, and we will not disclose the information to third parties. You acknowledge that we do not verify the age of our users nor do we have any liability to do so. If you are a child, please seek the permission of a parent or guardian before accessing our Website.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION FOR CALIFORNIA RESIDENTS

Under California law, specific disclosures are required and California residents have additional rights regarding their personal information. Please review this section to learn more.

YOUR CALIFORNIA CONSUMER PRIVACY ACT OF 2018 (CCPA) RIGHTS

Categories of Personal Information We Collect The California Consumer Privacy Act of 2018, as amended from time to time (“CCPA”) requires specific disclosures for each category of personal information that we collect.

Residents of California may have the following rights:

Right to know and access your personal information. Under CCPA, you have the right to: Know the categories of personal information we collect and the categories of sources from which we got the information;

Know the business or commercial purposes for which we collect and share personal information;

Know the categories of third parties and other entities with whom we share personal information; and

Access the specific pieces of personal information we have collected about you. To do so, please contact us at https://cash4goldanddiamond.com/. Please include your name, email address, and California postal address.

Right to deletion. In some circumstances, you may ask us to delete your personal information. To do so, please contact us at https://cash4goldanddiamond.com/. Please include your name, email address, and California postal address.

Right to opt out of sales. We may share your personal information with third parties in ways that may constitute a “sale” under CCPA. You may request that we not “sell” your personal information on a going forward basis. To do so, please contact us at https://cash4goldanddiamond.com/. Please include your name, email address, and California postal address.

Right to be free from discrimination. You may exercise any of the above rights without fear of being discriminated against.

For any of the above mentioned rights, you may designate an authorized agent to make a request on your behalf. In the request, you or your authorized agent must provide including information sufficient for us to confirm the identity of an authorized agent. We are required to verify that your agent has been properly authorized to request information on your behalf and this may take additional time to fulfill your request.

We will use the information you provide to make your CCPA rights requests to verify your identity, identify the personal information we may hold about you and act upon your request. Absolutely. We handle items from all over the world, appreciating the global nature of precious metals, diamonds, and watches.

Best Place to Sell Jewelry in Los Angeles: How to Choose the Right Buyer

Selling jewelry in Los Angeles can feel overwhelming because there are so many options—gold buyers, diamond dealers, pawn shops, jewelry stores, watch buyers, estate specialists, and online companies.

The best place to sell jewelry in Los Angeles is not necessarily the business advertising the biggest number.

A better question is:

Who can properly identify what I own, explain how it is being valued, and give me a real final offer after inspecting the item?

That matters because jewelry can contain several different types of value.

A gold chain may be valued primarily for its gold content.

A diamond engagement ring may involve gold value, diamond value, and potential resale value.

A Cartier bracelet, Rolex watch, antique piece, or inherited collection may require an entirely different evaluation.

Cash 4 Gold & Diamonds has served Los Angeles customers since 2007 and provides in-person evaluations at 617 S. Hill Street, Los Angeles, CA 90014, in the Downtown Los Angeles Jewelry District.

This guide explains how to compare jewelry buyers and what to look for before deciding where to sell.

What Makes a Good Jewelry Buyer in Los Angeles?

A professional jewelry buyer should understand more than gold weight.

Depending on what you’re selling, an evaluation may involve:

  • Gold purity
  • Precious-metal weight
  • Diamonds and gemstones
  • Designer or brand
  • Condition
  • Age
  • Authenticity
  • Collectibility
  • Original components
  • Current market demand
  • Resale potential
  • Supporting documentation

The right buyer for ordinary scrap gold may not necessarily be the best buyer for a large diamond, Rolex watch, or signed estate piece.

That is why expertise matters.

The Best Place to Sell Jewelry Depends on What You Own

Different types of jewelry require different evaluation methods.

Gold Jewelry

Gold jewelry is usually evaluated partly according to purity and weight.

Common gold purities include:

  • 10K — approximately 41.7% pure gold
  • 14K — approximately 58.3% pure gold
  • 18K — 75% pure gold
  • 22K — approximately 91.7% pure gold
  • 24K — approximately 99.9% pure gold

Gold market prices change throughout the trading day.

You can check current market information through an established source such as GoldPrice.org.

If you’re specifically selling gold, read our guide to selling gold jewelry in Los Angeles.

Diamond Jewelry

Diamond jewelry should not automatically be treated as gold plus a stone with no value.

Depending on the diamond, an evaluation may consider:

  • Carat weight
  • Cut
  • Color
  • Clarity
  • Shape
  • Measurements
  • Condition
  • Natural or laboratory-grown origin
  • Grading documentation
  • Current market demand

A GIA grading report can provide useful information when available, although a buyer may still need to inspect the actual diamond.

For diamond-selling information, visit our Los Angeles diamond buyer page.

Designer Jewelry

Certain designer pieces can potentially be worth more intact than simply calculating their precious-metal content.

Examples may include jewelry from recognized luxury houses such as:

  • Cartier
  • Tiffany & Co.
  • Van Cleef & Arpels
  • Bulgari
  • David Yurman
  • Other established designers

Designer evaluation can involve authenticity, collection, model, condition, age, original components, and current resale demand.

If you’re selling Cartier, see our guide to selling Cartier jewelry in Los Angeles.

For Tiffany pieces, read our Tiffany jewelry selling guide.

Luxury Watches

Luxury watches require specialized knowledge.

A Rolex should generally not be valued simply according to how much gold it contains.

A watch evaluation may consider:

  • Brand
  • Model
  • Reference number
  • Serial information
  • Age
  • Condition
  • Dial
  • Bracelet
  • Movement
  • Originality
  • Box
  • Papers
  • Current collector demand

If you’re considering selling a Rolex, visit our Rolex Buyer Los Angeles page.

Estate and Inherited Jewelry

Estate and inherited collections can be especially complicated.

One jewelry box may contain:

  • Ordinary gold
  • Diamond jewelry
  • Designer pieces
  • Antique jewelry
  • Platinum
  • Gold coins
  • Luxury watches
  • Sterling silver
  • Costume jewelry
  • Collectible pieces

Do not automatically assume everything should be grouped together and sold by weight.

An experienced buyer should first identify whether individual pieces deserve separate consideration.

Read our guide to selling estate jewelry in Los Angeles.

If the jewelry was inherited, see our guide to selling inherited jewelry with no obligation.

How Much Can You Receive for Your Jewelry?

There is no single percentage that applies to every jewelry item.

Depending on the specific jewelry item and its complete evaluation, Cash 4 Gold & Diamonds may pay approximately 80–95% of the relevant gold value.

Where an item falls within that range can depend on factors such as:

  • Purity
  • Weight
  • Jewelry type
  • Condition
  • Stones
  • Designer or brand
  • Refining considerations
  • Resale potential
  • Current market demand

A broken 10K chain and an 18K designer bracelet should not necessarily receive the same evaluation.

And for diamond jewelry, watches, coins, or designer pieces, the underlying gold value may not be the only important factor.

Rather than asking only:

“What percentage do you pay?”

Ask:

“What are you offering for my actual item, and how did you calculate it?”

The Highest Jewelry Quote Isn’t Always the Best Offer

This is especially important when comparing jewelry buyers.

A very high preliminary quote can sound attractive.

But a quote given before the buyer has physically examined your jewelry is not necessarily the amount you will actually receive.

Imagine calling several jewelry buyers.

Most provide similar estimates.

Then one business gives you a much higher number.

That high number becomes memorable.

Psychologists refer to this as anchoring.

Once a strong number is introduced, it can become the reference point you use to judge every later offer.

You may then visit several other buyers.

They inspect your jewelry, test it, examine the stones, and give you actual final offers.

But because none reaches the unusually high preliminary quote, you may think:

“The first buyer offered me more. I should go back there.”

When you return, the original number may change after the item is physically inspected.

The original estimate may have assumed a different:

  • Weight
  • Purity
  • Diamond quality
  • Condition
  • Brand
  • Model
  • Resale value

That does not mean every high quote is misleading.

Compare final offer with final offer—not preliminary estimate with final offer.

  • Does the designer name add value?
  • Are there deductions?
  • What amount would I actually receive if I sold the item now?

The highest number you hear first is not necessarily the highest amount you will ultimately receive.

Where Can You Sell Jewelry in Los Angeles?

Los Angeles sellers generally have several options.

Specialized Jewelry Buyers

A specialized buyer may evaluate multiple categories, including:

  • Gold
  • Diamonds
  • Designer jewelry
  • Estate jewelry
  • Coins
  • Luxury watches

This can be especially useful when you have a mixed collection.

Diamond Buyers

A diamond specialist may be appropriate for valuable loose diamonds or diamond jewelry.

The buyer should understand grading factors and current secondary-market demand.

Pawn Shops

Pawn shops commonly offer both collateral loans and outright purchases.

They can be convenient, but sellers should compare the actual purchase offer with other available options.

Do not assume every pawn shop offers less or every jewelry specialist offers more.

Compare the final offer.

Jewelry Stores

Some jewelry stores purchase pre-owned items, while others mainly focus on retail sales, repairs, or trade-ins.

Ask whether purchasing jewelry is a regular part of the business.

Online Jewelry Buyers

Online buyers can be convenient, particularly for people who do not live near a major jewelry market.

However, the item generally needs to be shipped before a final physical evaluation can occur.

If you’re comparing these options, read our guide to local gold buyers vs. online gold buyers.

Why Downtown Los Angeles Is a Major Jewelry Market

Downtown Los Angeles has one of the country’s best-known jewelry districts.

The Jewelry District contains a large concentration of:

  • Gold buyers
  • Jewelers
  • Diamond dealers
  • Watch specialists
  • Estate jewelry buyers
  • Coin dealers
  • Precious-metal businesses

That concentration gives local sellers the ability to research businesses and compare offers without automatically shipping valuable jewelry across the country.

Cash 4 Gold & Diamonds is located at:

617 S. Hill Street
Los Angeles, CA 90014

in the Downtown Los Angeles Jewelry District.

What Should You Bring When Selling Jewelry?

Bring the jewelry you want evaluated.

If you have relevant documentation, bring that too.

Helpful items can include:

  • Original receipts
  • Diamond grading reports
  • Designer certificates
  • Previous appraisals
  • Watch boxes
  • Watch papers
  • Coin documentation
  • Estate records

Documentation does not automatically increase an item’s value.

However, it may help identify or authenticate certain pieces.

For example, a GIA report can provide useful information about a diamond’s documented characteristics.

Do You Need a Receipt to Sell Jewelry?

Not necessarily.

An original retail receipt is not what determines the gold content, diamond quality, or current secondary-market value of most jewelry.

However, identification or transaction requirements may still apply.

Receipts and paperwork can also be useful when evaluating:

  • Designer jewelry
  • Diamonds
  • Watches
  • Coins
  • Estate pieces

Should You Clean Jewelry Before Selling It?

Usually, aggressive cleaning is unnecessary.

Polishing does not increase the amount of gold contained in an item.

Improper cleaning could potentially damage:

  • Antique jewelry
  • Gemstones
  • Special finishes
  • Designer pieces
  • Collectible items

If you’re unsure what you have, leave it as-is and let the buyer inspect it first.

How to Compare Jewelry Buyers

Before accepting an offer, ask:

  1. How did you identify my item?
  2. What purity did the gold test at?
  3. What weight are you using?
  4. How are you valuing the diamonds?
  5. Does the brand or designer add value?
  6. Is this an estimate or final offer?
  7. Are there fees or deductions?
  8. Does the piece have value beyond its materials?
  9. Am I free to decline the offer?
  10. What amount would I actually receive?

These questions can reveal more about a jewelry buyer than a large advertisement claiming the “highest price.”

Red Flags When Choosing a Jewelry Buyer

Be cautious if a buyer:

  • Refuses to explain the valuation
  • Will not explain weight or purity
  • Creates unnecessary pressure to sell immediately
  • Gives an extremely high quote before seeing the jewelry and cannot explain why it later changes
  • Is vague about deductions
  • Automatically ignores significant diamonds
  • Treats obvious designer pieces as scrap without inspection
  • Makes guarantees before knowing what you actually own

A professional buyer should be able to explain the major factors involved in the evaluation.

  • Purity

  • Current market demand

The goal is to identify what you actually have and provide an item-specific offer you can consider before deciding whether to sell.

Frequently Asked Questions About Selling Jewelry in Los Angeles

The best buyer depends on what you’re selling. Look for a buyer with relevant expertise, transparent evaluation practices, an established location, and the ability to explain the actual final offer for your particular item.

How much will I get for my jewelry?

The amount can depend on gold purity, weight, diamonds, gemstones, brand, condition, collectibility, resale potential, and current market demand.

No. A preliminary quote may be based on assumptions before the jewelry has been physically inspected. Compare final item-specific offers after each buyer has examined the actual piece.

Can I sell jewelry without a receipt?

In many cases, yes. Receipts are not necessarily required to evaluate an item’s materials or market value, although identification and other transaction requirements may apply.

Does having a certificate increase the value?

Not automatically. Documentation may help identify or authenticate a diamond, designer piece, watch, or other valuable item, but paperwork itself does not guarantee a higher offer.

Can I sell broken jewelry?

Yes. Broken gold jewelry can still retain precious-metal value. However, condition may matter when the complete item has designer, antique, collectible, or resale value.

If you’re uncertain about value, comparing multiple final item-specific offers can be useful.

Potentially valuable diamonds should be considered rather than automatically being ignored during a gold calculation.

Is it better to sell jewelry locally or online?

Both options can be legitimate. Selling locally allows you to keep possession of the jewelry until the evaluation and discuss the offer face-to-face. Online selling can be convenient but generally requires shipping before a final inspection.

Can I sell inherited jewelry if I don’t know what I have?

Yes. Inherited collections can be sorted and evaluated to identify gold, diamonds, designer pieces, watches, coins, antique jewelry, and other potentially valuable items.
